notes.title: [1.1.0] Quick Start Guide, Hint Tablet
notes.content:
Hello there!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Added a Quick Start Guide at the beginning to explain gameplay a bit more thoroughly than the briefing does. Some things overlap, but it's more of a technical explanation.
[*] Added a new mechanic/item: Hint Tablet. Now players can not only go back to check the missed anomaly, but also view its approximate (or sometimes very accurate) location if they choose so. All to help focusing attention for those last (or not) ones.
[*] Fixed issue with default dead zone drift not being taken into account for gamepad's stick input
[/list]

Enjoy!

There was one person who was very upset about fullscreen not working. Instead of reaching out to let me know and help fixing quickly, decided to throw shit at me. Hope you are reading this, despite not being written in Chinese. Have a good day. Chill a bit.
